in_subset_via: an epsilon of room证明集合为0测度的策略

callouts.id: 随机变量期望收敛导出几乎处处收敛的一个条件#1
callouts.title: 命题0
callouts.body: $X_n$是概率空间上的一列随机变量，假设$E(X_n)\to C$，并且这一列随机变量的方差收敛$\sum_{n\geq 1}V(X_n)< \infty$，那么$$X_n\xrightarrow{a.s.} C$$

classification_result.id: 随机变量期望收敛导出几乎处处收敛的一个条件#1

if_problem.statement_en: Let $X_n$ be a sequence of random variables on a probability space. Assume $E(X_n) \to C$ and that the sum of the variances satisfies $\sum_{n\geq 1} V(X_n) < \infty$. Then $$X_n \xrightarrow{a.s.} C.$$

callouts.id: 随机变量期望收敛导出几乎处处收敛的一个条件#2
callouts.title: 反例1
callouts.body: 考虑随机变量$X_n \sim \mathcal{N}(\frac{1}{\sqrt{n}},\frac{1}{n^2})$,那么显然均值是收敛到$C=0$的，并且方差的和是收敛的，不过此时$E(X_n)^2 = \frac{1}{n}$，这个和可并不收敛。

classification_result.id: 随机变量期望收敛导出几乎处处收敛的一个条件#2

if_problem.statement_en: Consider random variables $X_n \sim \mathcal{N}(\frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}, \frac{1}{n^2})$. Then clearly the means converge to $C=0$, and the series of variances converges. However, in this case $E(X_n)^2 = \frac{1}{n}$, and this series does not converge.

callouts.id: 随机变量期望收敛导出几乎处处收敛的一个条件#3
callouts.title: 想法2.1:间接证明几乎处处收敛的想法
callouts.body: 假设我们需要证明$f_n \xrightarrow{a.e.} f$,如果我们已经知道$g_n \xrightarrow{a.e.} f$,以及$|f_n-g_n| \xrightarrow{a.e.} 0$,那么我们就能立刻得到结果。换言之，如果我们知道别的对象也几乎处处收敛到目标函数$f$，比如这里的$g_n$，那么我们可以转而去想办法先证明$|f_n-g_n|$几乎处处收敛到0.

classification_result.id: 随机变量期望收敛导出几乎处处收敛的一个条件#3
classification_result.english_title: Idea 2.1: An Indirect Approach to Proving Almost Everywhere Convergence

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Indirect proof via comparison with a known convergent sequence
if_strategy_template.summary_en: To prove $f_n \xrightarrow{a.e.} f$, it is enough to find another sequence $g_n$ such that $g_n \xrightarrow{a.e.} f$ and $|f_n-g_n| \xrightarrow{a.e.} 0$. Then the target convergence follows immediately.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Use this when direct proof of almost everywhere convergence for $f_n$ is difficult, but one can compare $f_n$ to an auxiliary sequence $g_n$ already known to converge almost everywhere to the same limit.

callouts.id: 随机变量期望收敛导出几乎处处收敛的一个条件#4
callouts.title: 命题2.2
callouts.body: $f_n$是测度空间$(X,\mathcal{F},\mu)$上的一列可测函数列，记$E_{\mu}(f_n)=\int_X f_n\,d\mu$，$V_{\mu}(f_n)=\int_X (f_n-E_{\mu}f_n)^2\,d\mu$那么如果$$E_{\mu}(f_n)\to C$$并且$$\sum_{n\geq 1}V_{\mu}(f_n)<\infty$$那么$f_n\to C$在$X$上几乎处处成立。

classification_result.id: 随机变量期望收敛导出几乎处处收敛的一个条件#4

if_problem.statement_en: Let $f_n$ be a sequence of measurable functions on a measure space $(X, \mathcal{F}, \mu)$. Write $E_{\mu}(f_n)=\int_X f_n\,d\mu$ and $V_{\mu}(f_n)=\int_X (f_n-E_{\mu}f_n)^2\,d\mu$. If $$E_{\mu}(f_n) \to C$$ and $$\sum_{n\geq 1} V_{\mu}(f_n) < \infty,$$ then $f_n \to C$ almost everywhere on $X$.
